title: Senior Data Engineer, Lakehouse & Core Data Platform
text:
About Keystone Supply Network
Keystone Supply Network connects manufacturers, freight carriers, and distribution centers across 40 countries with real-time supply-chain visibility and predictive inventory analytics. Our data platform ingests billions of operational events every day to power customer-facing telemetry, financial reporting, and machine learning.

The Role
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Lakehouse & Core Data Platform team. You will architect distributed batch and streaming pipelines, model mission-critical dimensional tables in Snowflake and dbt, and ensure high data reliability across petabyte-scale datasets.

What You Will Do
- Build and scale distributed batch and streaming ETL pipelines in Python, Scala, and Apache Spark.
- Orchestrate complex production DAGs, SLAs, and historical backfill workflows with Apache Airflow.
- Design dimensional data warehouse models (Kimball star schemas, Slowly Changing Dimensions) using modular transformations in dbt and Snowflake.
- Build real-time Change Data Capture replication pipelines from operational relational databases into our streaming lakehouse.
- Diagnose and resolve data skew, shuffle spill, and Out-Of-Memory bottlenecks in petabyte-scale lakehouse jobs.
- Implement automated data quality testing, schema contract enforcement, and upstream/downstream lineage tracking.
- Optimize cloud data warehouse compute costs and table clustering while mentoring mid-level data engineers.

Requirements (Must-Haves)
- 5+ years of data engineering experience building distributed batch and streaming ETL pipelines in Python, Scala, and Apache Spark.
- Hands-on experience orchestrating production DAGs, SLAs, and backfill workflows with Apache Airflow.
- Deep expertise in dimensional data warehouse modeling (Kimball star schemas, Slowly Changing Dimensions) using dbt and Snowflake.
- Experience building real-time Change Data Capture replication pipelines from operational relational databases.
- Proven ability to diagnose and resolve data skew, shuffle spill, and Out-Of-Memory bottlenecks in petabyte-scale lakehouse jobs.
- Experience implementing automated data quality testing, schema contract enforcement, and lineage tracking.

Nice-to-Haves
- Track record of optimizing cloud data warehouse compute costs, table clustering, and storage footprint.
- Experience mentoring mid-level data engineers and partnering with analytics and ML teams on data governance standards.
- Hands-on experience with stateful stream processing in Apache Flink (RocksDB state backends, event-time watermarking).
- Experience administering enterprise BI semantic layers in LookML or Microsoft Power BI DAX.
